name: UNSC or Insurrectionist Air Force Soldier

traits.name: Skill Training
traits.effect: Begin with 3 Skills of the player's choosing at Trained during Character Creation.

traits.name: Vehicle
traits.effect: May purchase any UNSC Military Vehicle at 1/3rd cR cost. Vehicle becomes part of starting equipment, cannot be sold or traded, replenishes and repairs between missions, and is considered the party’s vehicle.

traits.name: Vehicle Swap
traits.effect: Between missions, may swap their starting vehicle for another UNSC Military Vehicle by paying 1/3rd of the new vehicle’s cost. No refunds.

traits.name: Squad Up
traits.effect: When with Army, Marine, Air Force, Navy, ORION, ODST, Militiaman, or Spartan IV Soldier Types: gain +5 Courage and +10 to Warfare Melee and Warfare Range when taking Combined Actions.

insurrectionist_rules.weapon_cost_increase: Weapons without the [I] tag cost 25% more.
insurrectionist_rules.modification_discount: Weapon and Vehicle Modifications cost half cR.

special_rules.vehicle_replacement: May replace starting vehicle between missions by paying 1/3rd cost of new vehicle.
